# netactuate_vpc_floating_ip (Resource)

Manages a VPC Floating Ip.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netactuate_vpc_floating_ip" "example" {
  ip_version = 4
  vpc_id     = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `ip_version` (Number) IP version (4 or 6)
- `vpc_id` (Number) The ID of the parent VPC

### Optional

- `ptr` (String) PTR record for the floating IP

### Read-Only

- `address` (String) The assigned floating IP address
- `floating_ip_id` (Number) The floating IP ID assigned by the API
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is the primary floating IP for its IP version

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netactuate_vpc_floating_ip.example 12345
```
